radius.focus.$description: Corner radius of the focus ring: radius.control + focus.offset, so the ring stays concentric with the control.

radius.indicator.$description: Corner radius of small companion content (counters, keycaps): a rectangle with slightly rounded corners, never a pill, so one and two digits read alike.

motion.duration.loop.$description: One cycle of a looping placeholder animation (Skeleton pulse, indeterminate Progress sweep).

opacity.muted.$description: Attenuation of companion content next to a label (a shortcut hint), so that it reads lighter than the text it accompanies.

opacity.tint.$description: A faint surface in the inherited content color behind small companion content (a counter's box), so that it follows its host without a border.

color.surface.inset.$description: A translucent tint that sets an area apart from whatever surface it sits on, darker in light and lighter in dark: the container of contained tabs (later a segmented control). Items lifted inside it use color.surface.overlay.

component.data-field.label-inline-size.$description: Inline size of the label column in the horizontal orientation, so that the values of separate fields line up; labels wrap within it. Below twice this size the field stacks.

component.divider.thickness.$description: Thickness of the line: 1 px in the base brand, independent of border.width.default so that a brand can change dividers without changing the borders of controls and surfaces.

component.progress.radius.$description: Corners of the track and the indicator: fully rounded in the base brand; a brand overrides it in its own components/progress.tokens.json (0 for rectangular bars).

component.spinner.track-opacity.$description: Opacity of the full ring drawn in the current color under the indicator.

component.tooltip.delay.$description: Hover delay before the tooltip opens; keyboard focus opens it at once.

component.tooltip.skip-delay.$description: After a tooltip closed, moving to another trigger within this time opens its tooltip at once (no hover delay).

component.tooltip.close-delay.$description: Grace after the pointer leaves the trigger, so that it can travel to the tooltip, which keeps it open.

component.tooltip.max-inline-size.$description: Maximum inline size; the text wraps beyond it.
